en: A colorized historical postcard view of a European spa town. It shows a river or canal running through a valley, lined with elegant multi‑story buildings on both sides. On the left is a grand civic building, while promenades and tree‑covered walkways follow the water. People in late 19th‑/early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the embankments and horse‑drawn carriages travel on the street. Forested hills rise in the background. Printed captions in German identify the scene as Karlsbad with specific streets or buildings.
